profile_text.body:
Litera is a legal technology company that describes itself as serving more than 1 million daily users and 99% of the Am Law 100, as well as 74% of the Fortune 100 in-house legal teams. The company positions its platform as a connected solution covering the full range of legal work, from matter scoping to drafting, integrated directly into Microsoft 365. It describes its accuracy as grounded in 30 years of experience, and has announced a company relaunch centered on a unified platform intended to operate across both the practice and business of law on one agent and one dataset.

Litera's primary AI product tracked on this site is Kira Systems, categorized under Finance and Legal AI. Kira Systems is focused on contract analysis, legal document review, attorney-client privilege risk, and handling of confidential data. Litera frames its broader AI offering as an ecosystem designed to help corporate legal teams bring more work in-house and reduce reliance on outside counsel, with an emphasis on outputs that meet the accuracy standards lawyers are willing to put their names to.

The site holds no recorded litigation, MCP server listings, or SEC or patent filings for Litera at this time.
